// lint-expect: 0
// lint-as: internal/identity/handlers.go
// identity's own decoder sits behind the gateway's capped forward (sprint m1-05 scope):
// only internal/gateway and internal/platform are scanned.

package identity

func decodeJSON(r *http.Request, v any) error {
	return json.NewDecoder(io.LimitReader(r.Body, 1<<20)).Decode(v)
}
